---
title: "matrix_meandering version 00"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
map <- matrix(".", nrow = 5, ncol = 5)
map[2, 3] <- "#"
map[3, 3] <- "#"
map[4, 2] <- "#"
map[4, 5] <- "X"
map[5, 4] <- "T"
map[1, 1] <- "@"
map[5, 2] <- "T"
map[1, 2] <- "T"

player_row <- 1
player_col <- 1

move <- function(direction) {
    if (direction == "up") {
        new_row <- player_row - 1
        new_col <- player_col
    } else if (direction == "down") {
        new_row <- player_row + 1
        new_col <- player_col
    } else if (direction == "left") {
        new_row <- player_row
        new_col <- player_col - 1
    } else if (direction == "right") {
        new_row <- player_row
        new_col <- player_col + 1
    }
    
    if (new_row < 1 | new_row > 5 | new_col < 1 | new_col > 5) {
        cat("Blocked! You've hit the edge of the dungeon.\n")
    } else if (map[new_row, new_col] == "#") {
        cat("Blocked by a large rock.\n")
    } else if (map[new_row, new_col] == "T") {
        cat("You found TREASURE!\n")
        map[player_row, player_col] <<- "."
        map[new_row, new_col] <<- "@"
        player_row <<- new_row
        player_col <<- new_col
    } else if (map[new_row, new_col] == "X") {
        cat("You found the exit!\n")
        map[player_row, player_col] <<- "X"
        map[new_row, new_col] <<- "@"
        player_row <<- new_row
        player_col <<- new_col
    } else {
        map[player_row, player_col] <<- "."
        map[new_row, new_col] <<- "@"
        player_row <<- new_row
        player_col <<- new_col
    }
    
    cat("\n")
    print(map)
}

map
```
